# cursor-hindsight-ondemand

> On-demand local Hindsight memory daemon for Cursor on Windows.

cursor-hindsight-ondemand starts `hindsight-embed` only when a Cursor agent session or MCP tools need memory — not at Windows logon. Traffic stays on `http://127.0.0.1:9077` so a cold start does not fall through to Hindsight Cloud. `ensure-daemon.ps1` refuses non-loopback BaseUrl unless `-AllowNonLocal` is set.

**Use this repo when:** you want local Cursor agent memory without a 24/7 Startup daemon; optionally a localhost hub linking official Hindsight UI + GitNexus web.  
**Do not use this repo for:** model routing YAML, or vendoring GitNexus itself.  
**Stack partner (public MIT):** [cursor-model-orchestrator](https://github.com/dapetun/cursor-model-orchestrator) — install `-Profile stack` for soft Hindsight `retain`. This repo is lifecycle only, not the model router.

**Privacy:** local HTTP API ≠ no LLM egress. Hindsight embed / Cursor may still send session text to configured providers. See docs/PRIVACY.md. Default example retain pacing: `retainEveryNTurns: 5` (`examples/cursor.json`); aggressive: `examples/cursor.full-retain.json`.

## Canon (orchestrator stack)

| Setting | Value |
|---------|--------|
| MCP server name | `hindsight` |
| Local API URL | `http://127.0.0.1:9077` |
| Preferred MCP launcher | `node ~/.hindsight/mcp-launch.mjs` (legacy: `mcp-launch.ps1`) |
| Dashboards skill | `memory-graph-dashboards` (no auto-start) |
| Hub / Memory UI / Control / GitNexus | `8765` / `19077` / `7878` / `4747` (loopback) |

## Quick facts

- Platform: Windows + PowerShell (+ Python hooks, Node for MCP)
- Cold start: typically 40–120s; set Cursor `sessionStart` timeout to 180
- License: MIT · DCO for contributions · Release: https://github.com/dapetun/cursor-hindsight-ondemand/releases/tag/v1.1.0

## Install

```powershell
git clone https://github.com/dapetun/cursor-hindsight-ondemand.git
cd cursor-hindsight-ondemand
.\install.ps1
.\install.ps1 -WriteHooks -WriteMcp -WriteCursorJson   # optional examples
```

## Upstream

- Hindsight: https://github.com/vectorize-io/hindsight
- Cursor: https://cursor.com

## Dashboards (optional)

```powershell
powershell -NoProfile -File $env:USERPROFILE\.hindsight\dashboard\start-dashboards.ps1 -Open
```

Installs with `install.ps1` into `~/.hindsight/dashboard` + `~/.cursor/skills/memory-graph-dashboards`. Does not start UIs until asked. See dashboard/README.md.

## Not included

GitNexus product binaries, model-routing YAML, and the `model-orchestrator` skill are out of scope. This repo covers on-demand Hindsight lifecycle wrappers plus an optional hub that *links* official Hindsight/GitNexus UIs when those tools are installed.
